focus: anti-SSRF (no new dereference), token-scrub parity, injection surface of the new per-item type field

findings.finding: No new URL dereference. The per-item type is a closed BlockType enum; mediaUrl handling is unchanged and still validated by requireMediaSource (http(s) scheme or opaque file_id) per item in validateAlbum. Backend still never fetches the media — Telegram does. Decision 6 invariant intact.

The Telegram media[].type wire value is produced by albumElementType from a closed enum mapping to four fixed literals (photo/video/audio/document). No user-controlled raw string reaches the wire type field. parseBlockType / MediaItemDto.type deserialize to the BlockType enum (unknown -> rejected with 422, never 400/500).
TelegramSender send/album mappers and scrubTokens paths are untouched by this change. Token-scrub parity preserved.
Preview RenderedMediaItem shape unchanged; no v-html introduced; parseMode escaping path unchanged. Out of scope of this correction but verified not regressed.

notes: No new attack surface. Anti-SSRF and token-scrub invariants hold.
